sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Widnes Town in a crucial fixture for both sides' campaigns. Sandbach sit sixth with 12 points and will be looking to build on their recent win, while Widnes languish at the bottom with just one point from four matches. This should present Sandbach with an excellent opportunity to climb further up the table against struggling opposition.
divisionWide: The title race sees leaders AFC Bridgnorth visit New Mills in a direct clash between two of the division's in-form sides—both level on 13 points with strong recent records. Stafford Town, also on 13 points, travel to Bilston Town looking to maintain their push at the top. In the middle of the table, Wolverhampton Casuals face Alsager Town in a match between contrasting runs, while Eccleshall host Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle of mid-table sides. Shawbury United's visit to Dawley Town pits two struggling teams against each other, as does the clash between bottom-half sides Crewe and Telford Town. Foley Meir entertain Brereton Social in a meeting of sides on similar points tallies, while Allscott Heath host Market Drayton Town—a fixture between two of the division's poorest performers. Barnton welcome Wednesfield Community as both teams seek to climb away from the relegation zone.
